tools.name: uk_logistics_operator_risk_check
tools.description: Search DVSA's real, live UK Vehicle Operator Licensing register -- every goods vehicle and PSV operator licence in Great Britain (69,127 operators, updated weekly) -- for a haulier or logistics operator by name. Returns licence status, authorised fleet size, and cross-references the operator's real Companies House status to flag a rare but real risk: a licence that still reads valid while the operator's actual registered company is dissolved or in liquidation.

query.description: Operator name or substring, e.g. 'Rhenus' or 'Wincanton'.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching operators to return.

payment_signature.description: Only set this after a prior call returned x402_payment_required and you've since signed the exact-scheme USDC payment it described with your own wallet -- set it to the resulting signed proof. Omit on a first attempt.
